title: EXPERIMENTAL: THREE MORE SWITCHES (NEEDED-ITEM GLOW, HAUL REVEAL, SHOP RE-ROLL)
why: The experimental page gets three display switches, on by default and read live in each window (they only change that window). Off: no box glows gold for an item a contract needs, the haul on the extracted card shows at once instead of one item at a time, and the shop stocks all four extras instead of two.
now: The experimental page switches the needed-item glow, the haul reveal and the shop re-roll.
